summary: Verified LOKAGER Module 0 launch-trigger fix. All storage gating is fully removed and countdown starts only on user tap. Launch screen consistently shows on both / and /launch even with pre-seeded legacy lokager_launched_seen and lokager_launch_started_at localStorage keys. No auto-start after 8s idle. Single tap starts countdown at 60 and decrements 1/sec smoothly (60→49 over 10s). Double-click does NOT start a second timer nor reset (60→54 over 5s = same rate as single tap, no reset to 60 after first tick). Refresh mid-countdown returns to opening launch screen. No /api requests fired. No lokager_* keys are ever written to localStorage (only unrelated posthog analytics key). Mobile 390x844: launch-button is 342x76px, fully in viewport, above the fold.
critical_code_review_comments: useLaunchCeremony.js correctly guards start() with startedAtRef; in-memory only, no persistence — matches spec.
CountdownNumber uses key={remaining} which remounts the span each tick — any test grabbing the element once will see stale text. Not a bug in app, just a testing note.
Ceremony.jsx has no route-level or storage-level resumption logic; refresh always yields idle phase — correct per spec.
seed_data_creation: Pre-seeded localStorage in-browser with lokager_launched_seen='1' and lokager_launch_started_at=now-20s before each initial navigation to simulate the founder's browser state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Countdown timer element uses key={remaining} so re-query [data-testid="countdown-timer"] on every sample; do not cache the ElementHandle. Full 60s → celebration → coming-soon sequence was verified in iteration_2; this iteration only re-verified the trigger fix + refresh behaviour + no localStorage writes.
